newsitem.title: FINLAND: IVO NAMES SALOMON ADVISER ON NESTE COOP .
newsitem.headline: IVO NAMES SALOMON ADVISER ON NESTE COOP .

text.p: Finnish state-owned power producer Imatran Voima Oy (IVO) said on Wednesday it had chosen Salomon Brothers International Ltd to advise it on opportunities for cooperation with Finnish energy group Neste Oy.

Salomon's review of prospects for cooperation between IVO and Neste could lead to "all kinds of results," IVO spokesman Antti Ruuskanen told Reuters by telephone, adding that the assessment would be completed by the end of August.
"One possibility is that the investigation would lead nowhere, and that the companies would continue to operate as they are now -- at the other end of the spectrum is a merger," he said.
Between those two possibilities lie many other cooperation opportunities, Ruuskanen said.
"The synergic business areas will have to be studied to see if cooperation or some kind of arrangement would increase the value to (the companies') owners," Ruuskanen said.
The ministry of trade and industry said in June it had started studies to assess the potential for developing IVO and Neste together.
